title: Sunflower-Oil Exports Were Headed Toward One Quarter of June’s Level
subtitle: July shipments fell 53.9% month over month, and the expected 40% further decline in August would reduce the export index to about 28.

supportingFacts.label: July export change from a year earlier.
Further export decline expected in August.
July domestic raw-sunflower price and monthly change.
Executive arrests added operational uncertainty in a major oils producer and logistics group.

note: The August index is derived as 46.1 × 0.60. June is normalized to 100 because the source reports percentage changes rather than absolute monthly tonnage.

metadata.keyFinding: Two consecutive export declines would leave August sunflower-oil shipments at about 28% of June’s level.
